cards.title: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
cards.titleEn: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting
cards.titleKo: 미국 초등학교 촬영에서 살았던 세 자녀와 교사
cards.summary: The suspect was shot dead by a community member who followed him into the Oregon school, police said. A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at a primary school in the US state of Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police said.
cards.summaryEn: The suspect was shot dead by a community member who followed him into the Oregon school, police said. A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at a primary school in the US state of Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police said.
cards.summaryKo: 의심의 여지도는 오레곤 학교에 그를 따르는 지역 사회 구성원에 의해 사망했다, 경찰은 말했다. 16 세는 죽은 세 자녀와 오레곤의 미국 국가의 초등학교에서 교사를 촬영하기 전에, 경찰은 말했다.
points: The suspect, who has not been named, forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend on Thursday afternoon by shooting at locked doors, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said.
The teenager was shot dead by a community member who "pursued him into the school and engaged him", Krantz said.
The three children killed were aged five, eight and 11.
pointsKo: 지명되지 않은 의심의 여지, 잠금 문에서 촬영하여 목요일 오후에 벤드의 도시에서 실버 레일 초등학교로 그의 길을 강제, 벤드 경찰 수석 마이크 Krantz 말했다.
청소년은 "학교에 그를 추구하고 그에게 관여 한 지역 사회 구성원에 의해 죽였다, Krantz는 말했다.
pointsEn: The suspect, who has not been named, forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend on Thursday afternoon by shooting at locked doors, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said.
The teenager was shot dead by a community member who "pursued him into the school and engaged him", Krantz said.
The three children killed were aged five, eight and 11.

cards.title: Alone in Gaza: Genocide leaves Palestinian man without family or a home
cards.titleEn: Alone in Gaza: Genocide leaves Palestinian man without family or a home
cards.titleKo: Gaza에서 혼자 : Genocide는 가족이나 집이없는 Palestinian 남자를 나눕니다.
cards.summary: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike. Gaza City, Gaza Strip – Every morning, Mahmoud Khalla goes to the nearby cemetery to visit the graves of the family members he lost during Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.
cards.summaryEn: One man wanders Gaza in search of somewhere to sleep, having lost his family in an Israeli strike. Gaza City, Gaza Strip – Every morning, Mahmoud Khalla goes to the nearby cemetery to visit the graves of the family members he lost during Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza.
cards.summaryKo: 한 사람 wanders Gaza 에 검색 의 어딘가에 잠, 잃은 그의 가족 이스라엘 파업. Gaza City, Gaza Strip – 매일 아침, Mahmoud Khalla는 Gaza에서 이스라엘의 영광스러운 전쟁 동안 잃어버린 가족 구성원의 무덤을 방문하는 인근 묘지에 간다.
points: He has held on to this morning routine in the months since he buried them, imagining his family is still around.
For Mahmoud, 40, the cemetery is the resting place of some of the people he has loved the most in his life.

His wife, his three children, his parents, his two brothers and their families, his sister and her children, and other relatives had all gathered in their family home in Jabalia, northern Gaza, on December 21, 2023.
pointsKo: 그는 그 후 달에이 아침에 일상 생활에 열리고, 그의 가족을 상상하는 것은 여전히 주변에 있습니다.
Mahmoud의 경우, 40, cemetery는 그의 인생에서 가장 사랑 받고있는 사람들의 일부의 휴식 장소입니다.
그의 아내, 그의 세 자녀, 그의 부모, 그의 두 형제와 그들의 가족, 그의 자매와 그녀의 자녀, 그리고 다른 상대는 모두에 모여 그들의 가족에 Jabalia, 북부 Gaza, 에 12월 21, 2023.
pointsEn: He has held on to this morning routine in the months since he buried them, imagining his family is still around.
For Mahmoud, 40, the cemetery is the resting place of some of the people he has loved the most in his life.

His wife, his three children, his parents, his two brothers and their families, his sister and her children, and other relatives had all gathered in their family home in Jabalia, northern Gaza, on December 21, 2023.

cards.summary: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month. The Chancellor, John Healey, is planning to increase taxes on bank profits, senior banking executives have told the BBC.
cards.summaryEn: Senior banking executives have told the BBC they expect to be "on the menu" in the chancellor's Budget tax later this month. The Chancellor, John Healey, is planning to increase taxes on bank profits, senior banking executives have told the BBC.

points: Healey has described banks as part of "the crown jewels" of the UK economy, but leaders in the sector have said it will be "on the menu" at the Budget in two weeks' time.

cards.title: A telling hole in a Neandertal bone hints at a bitter end
cards.titleEn: A telling hole in a Neandertal bone hints at a bitter end
cards.titleKo: 쓴 끝에 Neandertal 뼈 hints에 있는 말하는 구멍
cards.summary: An excavation at an iconic Neandertal burial site uncovers evidence for one individual's potential fatal wound as well as an injury endured for years. Freda Kreier was a fall 2021 intern at Science News.
cards.summaryEn: An excavation at an iconic Neandertal burial site uncovers evidence for one individual's potential fatal wound as well as an injury endured for years. Freda Kreier was a fall 2021 intern at Science News.
cards.summaryKo: 상징적 인 Neandertal burial 사이트에서 발굴은 한 개인의 잠재적 인 지방 상처뿐만 아니라 몇 년 동안 부상을 앓고 있습니다. Freda Kreier는 과학 뉴스에서 2021 인턴이었다.
points: She holds a bachelor’s degree in molecular biology from Colorado College and a master’s in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
A hole in this 75,000-year-old shoulder blade suggests that this Neandertal was stabbed by a spear around the time they died.
A new set of remains found in modern-day Iraq suggests that one Neandertal probably suffered a devastating blow to the face before dying at the point of a spear many years later.
pointsKo: 그녀는 콜로라도 대학의 분자 생물학 학사 학위와 캘리포니아 대학의 과학 커뮤니케이션 석사 학위를 보유하고 있습니다. Santa Cruz.
이 75,000 년 된 어깨 블레이드의 구멍은이 Neandertal이 그들이 사망 한 시간 주위에 두려움에 의해 안정되었다는 것을 제안합니다.
현대의 이라크에서 발견 된 새로운 세트는 몇 년 후 향신료의 시점에서 죽기 전에 얼굴에 파괴 타격을 겪은 것을 제안합니다.
pointsEn: She holds a bachelor’s degree in molecular biology from Colorado College and a master’s in science communication from the University of California, Santa Cruz.
A hole in this 75,000-year-old shoulder blade suggests that this Neandertal was stabbed by a spear around the time they died.

cards.title: Living with a stink? Technology might help
cards.titleEn: Living with a stink? Technology might help
cards.summary: Smells from rubbish dumps and industrial facilities are being more carefully monitored. The operators of Newby Island landfill have been ordered to take action over odours Milpitas, an affluent city in California's Silicon Valley tech hub, has an odour problem.
cards.summaryEn: Smells from rubbish dumps and industrial facilities are being more carefully monitored. The operators of Newby Island landfill have been ordered to take action over odours Milpitas, an affluent city in California's Silicon Valley tech hub, has an odour problem.
cards.summaryKo: 쓰레기 덤프 및 산업 시설의 냄새는 더 신중하게 모니터링됩니다. Newby Island Landfill의 운영자는 캘리포니아의 실리콘 밸리 기술 허브의 affluent 도시 인 odours Milpitas에 행동을 취하기 위해 명령되었습니다. odours Milpitas에 대한 조치를 취했습니다.
points: For decades, residents have had to endure rank smells wafting from industrial sites, among them a 342-acre landfill.
"When I first moved here, I could not open my window for over 10 years," says Chia-Ling Kong, an engineer for a tech firm who lives around half a mile from the dump.
pointsKo: 수십 년 동안 주민들은 산업 사이트에서 342 에이커 매립을 파괴 한 냄새를 견딜 수있었습니다.
"내가 처음 이동했을 때, 나는 10 년 이상 내 창을 열 수 없었다," Chia-Ling Kong 말한다, 덤프에서 반 마일을 사는 기술 회사에 대한 엔지니어.
pointsEn: For decades, residents have had to endure rank smells wafting from industrial sites, among them a 342-acre landfill.
"When I first moved here, I could not open my window for over 10 years," says Chia-Ling Kong, an engineer for a tech firm who lives around half a mile from the dump.

cards.title: (LEAD) Lee calls for constitutional revision to reflect spirit of democratization
cards.titleEn: (LEAD) Lee calls for constitutional revision to reflect spirit of democratization
cards.titleKo: (LEAD) 이 헌법 개정에 대한 호출은 민주화의 정신을 반영
cards.summary: (ATTN: UPDATES with more remarks from 5th para; ADDS photos) SEOUL, Oct. 16 (Yonhap) -- President Lee Jae Myung on Friday called on the National Assembly to push for a constitutional revision, saying the spirit of the country's democratization movements should be reflected in the Constitution.
cards.summaryEn: (ATTN: UPDATES with more remarks from 5th para; ADDS photos) SEOUL, Oct. 16 (Yonhap) -- President Lee Jae Myung on Friday called on the National Assembly to push for a constitutional revision, saying the spirit of the country's democratization movements should be reflected in the Constitution.
cards.summaryKo: (ATTN: UPDATES with more remarks from 5th para; ADDS photos) SEOUL, Oct. 16 (Yonhap) -- 대통령 Lee Jae Myung on Friday called on the National Assembly to Push for the 헌법 개정, 국가의 민주화 운동의 정신은 헌법에 반영되어야한다.
points: Lee made the call in a speech at a ceremony marking the 47th anniversary of the 1979 Busan-Masan pro-democracy protests against then President Park Chung-hee's dictatorship, also known as the Buma uprising.

"Reflecting the Buma democratization uprising and the Gwangju democratization movement in the preamble to the Constitution is the smallest measure we need to not forget the blood-stained history of defending South Kor…
"On this occasion, I once again request that the National Assembly begin gathering public opinions and holding reasonable discussions on constitutional reform," he said.
pointsKo: 이 행사는 1979년 부산마산의 47주년을 기념하여 박정희의 dictatorship 회장에 대한 연설을 하였다.
“부마 민주화 상승과 광주 민주화운동을 전개하는 헌법은 우리가 사우스 코를 방어의 혈종 역사를 잊지 못할 필요가있는 가장 작은 측정입니다 ...
"이 경우, 나는 다시 한 번 National Assembly가 대중의 의견을 모으고 헌법 개혁에 대한 합리적인 토론을 개최한다고 요청했습니다. "
pointsEn: Lee made the call in a speech at a ceremony marking the 47th anniversary of the 1979 Busan-Masan pro-democracy protests against then President Park Chung-hee's dictatorship, also known as the Buma uprising.

"Reflecting the Buma democratization uprising and the Gwangju democratization movement in the preamble to the Constitution is the smallest measure we need to not forget the blood-stained history of defending South Kor…
"On this occasion, I once again request that the National Assembly begin gathering public opinions and holding reasonable discussions on constitutional reform," he said.
